reasons: The candidate multiplies the sum by a constant 100 that does not appear in the Datadog source, which changes the quantity and unit (keys become percent-like values); the rules forbid this constant.
The Datadog query filters on $host (prefix host, default *), which should become a matcher host=~"$host"; the candidate drops this filter, so it selects a different set of series.
The $scope variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct; the $key variable is unused in the query and needs no matcher.
Aggregation (sum over all series) and the choice of redis.db.keys as a gauge summed across the db attribute match the Datadog sum of redis.keys, so the outcome of translated is appropriate.
